description: This file defines a PHP class 'FileManager' within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It implements functionalities for managing files and directories in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing directories, uploading files, and handling file-related operations such as generating thumbnails, filtering, pagination, and secure upload permissions.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: A controller class handling file management operations such as listing files/directories, uploading files, filtering, pagination, and thumbnail generation within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the file manager interface, setting language, preparing data for directory and file listing, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing of directory contents, including directories and images, with support for filtering and pagination.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Manages file upload requests, including permission checks, directory validation, and sanitization.

methods.name: folder
methods.description: Creates new folders within a specified directory, performing permission, validation, and sanitization checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files or directories, with validation and permission checks.
